zh.title: 捷星航空2027年起向大件行李收費新政策
zh.summary: 捷星2027年2月2日起對大件行李收費；歐洲廉航同步模式
body: 捷星航空宣布自2027年2月2日起，最低價機票僅含可置座位下的小型手提袋，乘客若需將大件行李放入頭頂行李架，須購買優先隨身行李服務。
同期捷星將隨身行李重量上限由7公斤提高至10公斤，並採用瑞安航空、易捷航空及威茲航空在歐洲已建立的收費模式，將頭頂行李架視為可出售的庫存。
顧問公司IdeaWorksCompany估算，若向頭頂行李架收費，表現最好的航空公司每位乘客可獲約20美元行李收入；歐洲廉航2025年行李費收入約160億美元，佔總收入近五分之一。特拉維亞航空2024年4月推出類似收費，第四季獲利超過2000萬歐元，平均每位乘客貢獻約4歐元。

en.title: Jetstar to Charge for Overhead Bin Space Starting February 2027
en.summary: Jetstar introduces overhead bin fee from February 2027; follows European low‑cost model
body: Jetstar announced that from 2 February 2027 its cheapest fares will include only a small under‑seat bag; passengers who want to place a larger bag in the overhead locker must purchase Priority Carry‑on.

At the same time the carrier raises the carry‑on weight limit from 7 kg to 10 kg and adopts the model used by Ryanair, easyJet and Wizz Air in Europe, treating overhead bin space as sellable inventory.

IdeaWorksCompany estimates top airlines can earn about US$20 per passenger from overhead‑bin fees; European low‑cost carriers collected roughly US$16 billion in baggage fees in 2025, accounting for nearly one‑fifth of revenue. Transavia introduced a similar charge in April 2024 and disclosed more than €20 million in Q4 revenue, averaging about €4 per passenger with a €30 fee and an estimated 13 % uptake.

facts.claim: Jetstar will charge for overhead locker space from 2 February 2027, with cheapest fares including only a small under‑seat bag and larger bags requiring Priority Carry‑on purchase.
facts.sourceQuote: From 2 February 2027, its cheapest fares will include only a small bag that fits under the seat. Passengers wanting to place a larger bag in the overhead locker space will need to buy Priority Carry-on.

facts.claim: Jetstar is increasing its carry‑on weight limit from 7 kg to 10 kg.
facts.sourceQuote: The Australian low-cost carrier is also increasing its existing 7kg carry-on weight limit to 10kg.

facts.claim: Jetstar follows the European low‑cost model of Ryanair, easyJet and Wizz Air, which include a small under‑seat bag in basic fares and charge for overhead bin use.
facts.sourceQuote: Jetstar is following a model already established by Ryanair , easyJet and Wizz Air in Europe. All three include a small underseat bag in their basic fares and charge passengers who want to put a larger bag in an overhead bin.

facts.claim: IdeaWorksCompany estimates top‑performing airlines can generate around US$20 per passenger in baggage revenue when charging for overhead carry‑on bags.
facts.sourceQuote: Research from airline ancillary revenue consultancy IdeaWorksCompany suggests top-performing airlines can generate around $20 in baggage revenue per passenger when they charge for overhead carry-on bags.

facts.claim: European airlines collected about US$16 billion in baggage fees in 2025, with roughly 60 % going to low‑cost carriers, and baggage fees represent just under one‑fifth of total revenue at European budget airlines.
facts.sourceQuote: IdeaWorks estimates European airlines collected about $16 billion in baggage fees in 2025, with around 60% going to low-cost carriers. Baggage fees are estimated to contribute just under one-fifth of total revenue at European budget airlines.

facts.claim: Transavia introduced overhead carry‑on charges in April 2024, disclosed over €20 million in Q4 revenue from the fee, carried nearly five million passengers, yielding an average €4 per passenger with a €30 fee and an estimated 13 % purchase rate.
facts.sourceQuote: Transavia, Air France-KLM’s low-cost airline, introduced charges for overhead carry-on bags in April 2024. It subsequently disclosed more than €20 million in revenue from the fees during the fourth quarter alone. The airline carried almost five million passengers during that period. IdeaWorks calculated that the new charge produced an average of about €4 per passenger the airline carried, including those who did not buy an overhead bag. Based on an average fee of €30, IdeaWorks estimated only around 13% of passengers needed to buy the product to produce that revenue.
